card.name: Linking words before place or drug names
card.fires_on: Small linking words (in, to, of, the, a comma) and spaces before a number, mostly in travel/geography text and in ganciclovir/valganciclovir dosing text. The next word is a place name or a drug or dose term.

modes.label: Geography links
modes.description: Small linking word or comma just before a place name or region in travel and geography text.
modes.example: Smaller bodies of water are Lake Velence (26 square km)<< in>> Fejér County and Lake Fert

modes.label: Ganciclovir text
modes.description: Linking word before the drug name, or the space before a dose number, in valganciclovir/ganciclovir dosing text.
modes.example: because valganciclovir is rapidly and extensively converted<< to>> ganciclovir, drug-dr

card.writes: It suppresses other place names (Maine, Latvia, Florida) and promotes Chinese city names like Hangzhou and West Lake, so the effect is unclear.
card.plain: It fires on small linking words just before a place name or a ganciclovir dose, with no single clear meaning.
